basic_info.description: Stylish and unique ClockTower loft in the coveted tower of this iconic and historic South Beach building. Designed by Studio 12, Unit T660 spans approx. 1,846 sq. ft. with soaring 14' ceilings, a dramatic hallway perfect for art display, and a prism-inspired layout that reflects natural light across the interior. Industrial concrete ceilings and columns contrast beautifully with rich hardwood floors and a warm custom floating staircase. The expansive living and dining area boasts floor-to-ceiling windows with sweeping south-facing views of the water and the city. The open gourmet kitchen is outfitted with deluxe appliances (Bosch, SubZero, Fisher Paykel), slate flooring, a butcher-block island, stainless countertops, pantry cabinets, and a built-in desk under the stairs. Off the entry is a private den (legal use) or second bedroom with built-ins and a sleek slate bathroom with shower. Upstairs is a fabulous primary suite with operable glass panels, a contemporary bath with a glass-enclosed shower, and an expansive walk-in closet with in-unit laundry. Includes 2-car indoor garage parking, shared courtyard, and roof deck with city views. Surrounded by world-class dining,shopping, and entertainment;close to Oracle Park, Embarcadero waterfront,Chase Center,and transportation options.
